correctness.rationale: All four Cassinian membership inequalities are explicit. The product comparison reduces to a one-variable radical inequality with a sign-safe squaring step on r>=1/4 and the exact factorization (r-1)((r+1)^3-2). The parameter map is strictly increasing, giving the stated endpoints. The bundled checker verifies the algebraic factorization and exact rational witness; no finite experiment is used as proof.

value.rationale: Question 6.2 proposes a natural Cassinian rectangle extension of the proved Reuleaux square. The common corner product is the square theorem’s target value. Showing that an explicit boundary/diagonal triple overtakes it on an exact sharp interval is a structurally motivated obstruction to the obvious extension strategy and supplies a reusable threshold, even though it does not solve the full constant-3-diameter question.
